name: wpcustomca Product Gallery Alt Editor for WooCommerce
author: wpcustom.ca

sections.description:
wpcustomca Product Gallery Alt Editor for WooCommerce helps WooCommerce store admins quickly manage image ALT text for product featured images and product gallery images.

The plugin provides two admin tabs:

Products

View WooCommerce products with AJAX-based loading, search, pagination, featured images, and gallery images.

Categories

Filter and load products by WooCommerce category using AJAX.

Main features:

  • AJAX-based product loading
  • Product management screen for WooCommerce products
  • Category-based product filtering
  • Product search
  • Pagination
  • Featured product image preview
  • Product gallery image preview
  • Inline ALT text editing
  • Save ALT text without reloading the page
  • Add or upload product gallery images
  • Select multiple images from the WordPress Media Library
  • Automatically save selected images to the WooCommerce product gallery
  • Refresh product gallery images after saving
  • WooCommerce admin-focused interface

This plugin is designed for store administrators who need a faster way to manage product image accessibility and image ALT text without opening every media item separately.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Product Gallery ALT Editor.
  5. Use the Products or Categories tab to load products.
  6. Edit image ALT text and click the Save ALT button.
  7. Use Add / Upload Gallery Images to add images to a product gallery.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I edit product featured image ALT text?

Yes. Featured product images are displayed and their ALT text can be edited.

Can I edit product gallery image ALT text?

Yes. Product gallery images are displayed with inline ALT fields.

Does saving ALT text reload the page?

No. ALT text is saved using AJAX.

Can I add new gallery images from this plugin?

Yes. You can select or upload multiple images using the WordPress Media Library and add them to the WooCommerce product gallery.

Can I filter products by category?

Yes. Use the Categories tab to select a WooCommerce product category.

Can I search products?

Yes. The Products section includes AJAX-based product search.

Does the plugin support pagination?

Yes. Products can be loaded with AJAX pagination.

Who can use this plugin?

The plugin is intended for authorized WordPress administrators and users with the required WooCommerce product management permissions.
